statement: Incorporating a New Zealand company on the Companies Register starts with reserving a company name ($10 plus GST online), which gives 20 working days to complete the incorporation; the application must register every director (each signing a consent form certifying they can and agree to be a director), register every shareholder (each signing a consent form) with the number of shares each holds, and provide the company's registered office, address for service, and correspondence addresses.
caveat: The Companies Office processes applications online; constitution filing is optional and ultimate-holding-company and shareholder details carry their own fields. The underlying provisions are Companies Act 1993 ss 10, 12, and 22 (legislation.govt.nz answers automated fetches with an AWS WAF challenge, recorded 2026-10-23). Check the live Companies Office guidance before filing.
